Rep. Maggie Goodlander won the New Hampshire Democratic primary in District 2, advancing to November's general election against Republican nominee Lily Tang Williams.

Goodlander maintains a deep policy background as a legal scholar and former Justice Department official independent of her family connections.

The coverage commits a Metaphysical Plane error (WHO), substituting candidate identity and policy platform with spouse association to score partisan points.

The Unavoidable Truth: Established party infrastructure and fundraising strongly predict primary outcomes regardless of external partisan attacks.
The Unavoidable Lie: A candidate's legislative qualifications are dictated by their spouse's career.
